title.zh: Mandelbrot 集 · 迭代出来的分形
title.en: The Mandelbrot set · a fractal grown by iteration

description.zh: 从 z = 0 出发反复计算 z ← z² + c，平面上的每个点 c 只有两种命运：永远留在半径 2 的圆内（属于集合）或迟早逃逸；按命运给所有点上色，一行算术就长出一条怎么放大细节都不枯竭的分形边界。
description.en: Starting from z = 0 and repeating z ← z² + c, every point c of the plane has one of two fates: it stays inside the circle of radius 2 forever (it belongs to the set) or sooner or later escapes; colouring all points by their fate grows, from one line of arithmetic, a fractal boundary whose detail never runs out however far you zoom.

label.en: z² is squaring a complex number

reason.zh: 迭代的每一步都是复数运算：平方让模长平方、辐角加倍，再平移一个 c；把复数乘法看成旋转加伸缩，才看得懂轨道为什么会盘旋或飞走。
reason.en: Each step of the iteration is complex arithmetic: squaring squares the length and doubles the angle, then c shifts the point; seeing complex multiplication as rotate-and-scale is what makes it clear why orbits spiral in or fly away.
